newsitem.title: GERMANY: Shareholder group bemoans Deutsche image blow.
newsitem.headline: Shareholder group bemoans Deutsche image blow.

text.p: A German small shareholders' protection group on Tuesday bemoaned Deutsche Bank AG's "catastrophic loss of image" as a result of last week's crisis at its London MGAM funds unit.

Reinhild Keitel, a director of the Schutzgemeinshaft der Kleinaktionaere, told German radio that shareholders would most probably bear the brunt of the scandal which led to the temporary suspension of three funds and a 180 million stg liquidity injection from Deutsche Bank.
"This was a total failure of internal controls," Keitel said.

Keitel noted that a similar incident was unlikely to occur in Germany, although this week's demand for fund companies to reveal the make-up of their funds illustrated that authorities had some concerns on that score.
